name: Onushilon360
summary: Onushilon360 is a university admission preparation platform for Bangladesh, offering timed mock exams, past-paper practice, and student progress tracking, with exam management tools for education providers.

features.title: Timed mock exams
features.description: Take timed exams with multiple-choice and written questions. Answers autosave during the exam, and staff can review written submissions after it ends.

features.title: Past papers and question practice
features.description: Browse past admission papers, practise individual questions, bookmark questions to revisit, and check explanations for multiple-choice answers.

features.title: Results and progress tracking
features.description: Review scores, see progress by subject, and compare results on exam leaderboards.

features.title: Exam and question bank management
features.description: Staff can build and schedule exams, organise question banks, grade written answers, and review student results.

audience: Students preparing for university admission tests in Bangladesh
tagline: Online university admission test preparation platform
description: Onushilon360 helps students prepare for university admission tests in Bangladesh. Students can take timed mock exams, practise with past admission questions, and track their progress. Coaching centres and education providers can use the platform to manage question banks, schedule exams, grade written answers, and review student results from a staff dashboard.
